project.name: osgi/domains/ghapp
project.description: The ghapp domain: the GitHub App identity. It registers the one org-owned GitHub App (manifest flow, a one-time human approval) and mints short-lived, scoped installation tokens from its sealed private key — the writer's `contents:write` push token host-side, and the App-auth material Flux and the github-app-operator consume in-cluster. Supersedes the personal `gh auth token` credential path.
